item.title: Blue tsunami wipes out $2.5 trillion from Nasdaq as investors fret about AI trade
item.description: It was the second straight day of selling in AI stocks and the fifth decline of more than 500 points in the Nasdaq Composite since mid-October.

item.title: Mariko Mori predicted the future. She’ll do it again.
item.description: Mariko Mori's first solo exhibition in 24 years thrusts her back in the spotlight in Japan.

item.title: French protests draw 575,000 amid parliament budget impasse
item.description: The office of Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has announced he will call labor unions to a conference to present responses to their demands.

item.title: Noto quake victims’ family sues government and building owner over fatal collapse
item.description: A seven-story building collapsed in the 2024 earthquake, killing a man's wife and daughter while crushing his house and restaurant next door.

item.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
item.description: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
